breaking_news.headline: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
breaking_news.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

breaking_news.headline: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
breaking_news.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

breaking_news.headline: Should you trust new AI agents with your money and data?
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies want agentic AI to be the new way you shop. But should you trust AI when your money's involved?

breaking_news.headline: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

breaking_news.headline: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
breaking_news.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

breaking_news.headline: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
breaking_news.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
breaking_news.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

breaking_news.headline: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
breaking_news.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.

breaking_news.headline: Five new miniature frog species found in eastern Himalayas
breaking_news.summary: Scientists say the frogs evolved as the Himalayas rose and the Asian monsoon took shape.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
breaking_news.summary: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

breaking_news.headline: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
breaking_news.summary: Medical staff are going unpaid, lack proper training and are struggling with shortages of essential supplies, MSF warns

breaking_news.headline: Pentagon backs war memorial guard who reprimanded Hegseth's group
breaking_news.summary: The defence secretary on Thursday awarded the soldier, Specialist Thomas Iglesias, a Joint Service Commendation Medal for the execution of his duties.

breaking_news.headline: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
breaking_news.summary: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

breaking_news.headline: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools

breaking_news.headline: 'We've got to run': Inside ruined Ukraine power plant under constant drone threat

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow
breaking_news.summary: Later on Thursday, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will travel to Dublin to meet Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate alleged Chinese spy affair

breaking_news.headline: Christmas toy rush being driven by squishies and building sets
breaking_news.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.

breaking_news.headline: Some under-25s should get fewer benefits, Milburn review to say
